question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Decapitate
solution:
The correct answer is **"Behead".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Decapitate"** means to cut off a person’s head. ((किसी व्‍यक्ति का) सिर धड़ से अलग कर देना, शिरच्‍छेद करना)

 
 
• **Example:** *In the middle ages, thieves were sometimes **decapitated**__ as punishment.*
 
 
 
• **"Behead" **means to remove the head of a person, typically as a form of capital punishment. (किसी का सिर काट देना, विशेषतः दंडस्‍वरूप)
 __
 
• **Example:** *The king ordered to **behead**__ the traitor.*
 
 
 
• **"Behead"** is a synonym for **"decapitate".**
 
• So, the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Affection"** is a noun that means a gentle feeling of fondness or liking. (अनुराग, स्‍नेह)
 
• **"Sincerity"** is the quality of being free from pretence, deceit, or hypocrisy. (ईमानदारी, सच्‍चाई)
 
• **"Desolation"** is a state of complete emptiness or destruction. (अवसाद, निराशा)
